inputs.core_mode == 'mathlib-raw-vo-basis' && '-mathlib-raw-vo-basis' || 
  raw-vo-basis:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.core_mode == 'mathlib-raw-vo-basis' && github.event.repository.private == false }}
    name: First token0 and position0 split V/O basis (full basis open)
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 75
    env:
      LEAN_NUM_THREADS: "2"
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      MKL_NUM_THREADS: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Download exact37 accepted O/U/CU archives (no extraction)
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${{ github.event.repository.private }}" = false
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvobasis"
          for artifact in $(python3 -B transformer/mathlib/rawvobasis_restore.py --artifact-ids); do
            gh api --method GET "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/$artifact" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvobasis/$artifact.json"
            curl --request GET --fail --location --retry 2 --silent --show-error \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
              "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/$artifact/zip" \
              -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvobasis/$artifact.zip"
          done
      - name: Actual37 V/O dependency metadata controls (non-kernel)
        run: |
          TMPDIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvobasis" python3 -B -W error transformer/mathlib/test_rawvobasis.py --archives "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvobasis"
      - name: Install pinned stable compiler
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leanprover/elan/master/elan-init.sh -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvobasis/elan-init.sh"
          sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvobasis/elan-init.sh" -y --default-toolchain none
          echo "$HOME/.elan/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Mathlib dependencies only (serial Lake)
        timeout-minutes: 9
        run: |
          cd transformer/mathlib
          timeout -s TERM -k 20 480 lake exe cache get
      - name: Restore301, support then first coordinate and scalar chunk16 V/O basis
        timeout-minutes: 57
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd transformer/mathlib
          ./rawvobasis.sh --archives "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvobasis" 2>&1 | tee rawvobasis.ci.out
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: transformer-raw-vo-basis-${{ github.run_id }}
